name: Needle-Nose Pliers
tagline: Reach into tight junction boxes and bend small hoops without catching neighbouring wires.
parts: Long tapered jaws — reach into deep boxes
Cutting edge — trim thin conductors to length
Pivot joint — keeps the two halves aligned
Comfort grips — reduce hand fatigue for repetitive bending
safety: Pliers are insulated to a stated voltage (try to pick ones rated at least 1000 V or category III). Never use the jaw tips like a lever against a live terminal.

points.label: Long tapered jaws
points.detail:
Needle-nose jaws reach into crammed junction boxes and pull a stranded core through without snagging.

Use the flat inner faces for bending neat right-angle hoops for terminals — the pointy tip is a liability if you slip.

points.label: Cutting edge
points.detail:
The small shear behind the pivot cleanly trims thin (≤2.5 mm²) conductors and cable ties.

Cut at right angles, not on the flat — and only wire that is not live.

points.label: Pivot joint
points.detail: The riveted pivot holds the two halves in a perfect plane so the jaw tips meet exactly — that is what makes the tool turn torque into a controlled pinch instead of a twist.

points.label: Comfort grips
points.detail: Moulded rubber sleeves fit the palm and reduce fatigue when you are cranking dozens of bends. Wash off grease now and then — the grip is what keeps the tool from spinning in your hand.
